drums.tags: Boom bap hip hop instrumental. A gritty, lo-fi drum break features a heavy, thumping kick and a crisp, layered snare with a slight swing. A prominent, repetitive bassline consists of a deep, sub-heavy synth tone playing a syncopated two-bar loop. A melodic hook is provided by a sampled, high-pitched soul vocal chop, heavily processed with a band-pass filter and short delay. Atmospheric texture is added by a vinyl crackle layer and occasional, muted electric piano chords with a tremolo effect. The track maintains a steady 92 BPM in the key of C minor.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[vinyl crackle, lo-fi drum break enters]
[syncopated synth bass enters]

[Main Section]
[filtered vocal chop loop enters]
[muted electric piano chords with tremolo]
[heavy kick and snare backbeat]

[Breakdown]
[vocal chop drops out]
[bass and drums continue with vinyl crackle]

[Outro]
[vocal chop re-enters]
[instruments fade out leaving only vinyl crackle]

bass.tags: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences. The track features a distorted, overdriven kick drum with a long decay providing a sub-bass rumble. A metallic, percussive synth sequence runs in sixteenth notes with a resonant filter sweep. A high-pitched, dissonant industrial alarm sound repeats every four bars. The percussion includes a sharp, white-noise snare on the backbeat and a constant, un-swung closed hi-hat on every eighth note. A low-frequency sawtooth bassline enters mid-track, playing a syncopated two-note pattern. The production is dry with minimal reverb, emphasizing a cold, mechanical texture. 135 BPM, 4/4 time signature, Key of D minor.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted kick drum enters with sub-bass tail]
[metallic sixteenth-note synth sequence]

[Section A]
[white-noise snare on beats 2 and 4]
[closed hi-hat on eighth notes]
[dissonant industrial alarm sound repeats]

[Section B]
[sawtooth bassline enters, syncopated pattern]
[resonant filter sweep on synth sequence]

[Outro]
[percussion drops out]
[distorted kick fades to sub-rumble]
[synth sequence fades out]
